20. Eurythmy Performance
Dear attendees! The eurythmic art that we are going to present to you is based on the Goethean artistic ethos. Everything that is striven for in this building and everything that is connected with it essentially wants to be a continuation of everything that is inherent in the Goethean worldview. The attempt to create eurythmy is based on the artistic application of the great and comprehensive aspects of Goethe's world view to a specific, narrowly defined field.
